_comment: Curated inputs to docs/CURRENT_STATE.json. Structural data (branches, stacks, PR relations, CI) is computed by `python3 -m drive_mirror current-state`; only judgement-dependent statements live here, each with evidence. Not design authority.

conflicts.title: Royal chest implemented twice (D13-03 stack vs ST-01 stack)
conflicts.divergence: Both sides define the same classes (RoyalChestContainer/Data/Menu/RewardModel/Role/Runtime). Side B is a superset in the persistence layer (extra members index, positions, canonicalId, validPrimary; RoyalChestData 221 vs 197 lines, RoyalChestRuntime 166 vs 143). RoyalChestMenu, RoyalChestRewardModel and RoyalChestRole are the same size on both sides. Each side carries authority documents the other lacks.
shared_dependencies: PyramidRoyalChestRewards (accessory reward constants and pure draw, from I05 18362bb9)
Heart of Gravity / Ancient Heart Tomb Guardian drops (I03, #235)
possible_strategies: A. Keep the D13-03 I05/I06 implementation as the base and port the dual-half persistence from #254 on top.
B. Keep #254 as the base and port the I06 reward engine (#243) on top.
C. First extract the identical pure model (RoyalChestRewardModel, RoyalChestRole) into a small shared change, then reconcile the persistence layer.
D. Merge sequentially: integrate one stack, then rebase the other onto it and resolve once.
verification_required_after_reconciliati: git merge-tree of the two tips reports no conflicts
GameTests: RoyalChestGameTests, St01RoyalChestGameTests, Tomb Guardian loot test, full runGameTest
ST-01 Royal Chest Runtime restart-persistence workflow
Owner confirms which reward authority governs chest semantics (D13-03 I06 Q01-Q45 vs ST-01 independent royal tomb requirements)

evidence: docs/STRUCTURE_AUTHORITY_INDEX.md blob 2ab2dbe0 on work/st01-p8c2a-complete-assembly-20261110-r1, claude/st01-pyramid-phase4-worldgen-roke2l and work/st01-g0-r1-blueprint-finalization-20261110: ST-01 design row still reads 'Implementation is not authorized'

owner_decisions_required.question: Which branch is the integration baseline going forward? main has had no merge since 2026-10-22; checkpoint/wave16-unified-20261104 is the newest unified checkpoint by convention only.
Which royal-chest implementation (or what combination) is current? (C-1)
Do the ST-01 conditional-approval records authorize implementation, and should the structure index row be amended? (C-2)
Should #249/#251/#252 keep main as their base? They carry 365-371 commits over main (the whole wave16 line plus the ST-01 stack).
Disposition of stale stacks (Stage 23 era, PRC-P7, pre-wave16 ST-05) and of the 50 PR heads that no branch contains (the mirror now preserves them under pulls/ once live sync runs).

Approve (or reject) the proposed classification of secret-scan fingerprint cec8bff8:...:generic-api-key:23 as a false positive, and decide where its allowlist entry lives. main's .gitleaksignore has 2 entries; wave16's has 11; a push to main would currently report 10 findings.
Apply the prepared documentation corrections (patches/docs) to the protected checkpoint/stack branches?
Apply the Colosseum clock-seam patch (and, for D13 I01-I04a, the design-linked Tomb Guardian test alignment) to the affected stacks?
Approve the separately-scoped full Git history archive extension (git bundle and/or commit-graph metadata)? Not implemented.

Choose the Drive destination (Workspace shared drive vs personal account), approve merging tools/drive_mirror and the workflow into main, and approve enabling DRIVE_MIRROR_ENABLED after the controlled live test.

security.verdict: NOT READY for live Drive sync until D-6 is decided; no confirmed exposed credential
security.summary: Full-history scan (gitleaks 8.30.1, 2005 commits, 133 branches + PR heads): 12 findings, 0 confirmed credentials. 10 are already reviewed/allowlisted by the owner (1 synthetic test fixture, 9 byte-identical copies of one reviewed prose false positive plus the original). 1 (cec8bff8) is a document-name manifest flagged by the generic-api-key rule; analysis says false positive, but it is only 'proposed' until the owner approves it. The mirror's security gate quarantines exactly the refs whose tip tree contains it.

documentation_state.summary: main's authority indexes date from 2026-10-22; checkpoint/wave16's from 2026-11-04; later stacks add authority records that no checkpoint contains. Historical records were preserved; corrections for protected branches are prepared as patches, not applied.

PR #181 closed (branch still exists; not in main or wave16)

mirror.status: implemented and emulator-verified; live Google Drive verification BLOCKED (no credentials or destination)
mirror.scope: all refs/heads/*, refs/tags/*, and PR heads that no branch contains (pulls/), exact paths and bytes, manifests with source ref and commit
mirror.not_in_scope: full Git history (separately approvable extension, D-9)

unresolved_uncertainties.statement: Behaviour of the real Google Drive API (quotas, rate limits, checksum availability, error codes) has not been observed; only an emulator was used.
For 11 of the 42 PARTIAL research rows the cited handler is a vanilla or mixin method rather than a class, so the code claim was not mechanically checked; behaviour-level claims remain unverified.
That the Colosseum clock seam is the cause of the CI difference is supported by association and a local before/after run, not proven.
The royal_tomb_flow follower-west GameTest failure on #251/#252 was not investigated.
